dashboard.loginHint: Account status (linked devices, sync versions) is visible right away. Your synced data stays end-to-end encrypted and is never visible to the server - you can optionally decrypt it right here in your browser with your recovery passphrase.
dashboard.wrongPassphrase: Wrong recovery passphrase - could not unlock.
dashboard.noBookmarksSynced: No bookmarks have been synced yet.
dashboard.devicesHint: Every device currently signed into this account. Revoke anything you don't recognize - a "never used" badge usually means a leftover from reinstalling the extension rather than a device someone's actually using.
dashboard.dataViewerHint: Decrypted entirely in this browser tab using your recovery passphrase - the passphrase and the decrypted data never leave your device or reach the server. Closing this window forgets both.
dashboard.passwordsWarning: This page's code is served by the BrowserSync server. Only unlock your passwords here if you trust whoever runs it - the browser extension doesn't have this risk.
dashboard.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} - use the filter to narrow it down.
dashboard.nothingSyncedYet: Nothing synced yet - install the extension and sync from a device.
dashboard.exportBackupHint: Downloads your synced passwords and bookmarks in one file encrypted with a backup password you choose. Restore it from the extension (popup settings → "Export / import a backup").
dashboard.exportCsvDone: Exported {{count}} passwords. Delete the CSV file once you've imported it.
dashboard.exportBackupDone: Backup downloaded. Store it somewhere safe, separately from its password.
dashboard.backupPasswordTooShort: The backup password needs at least {{min}} characters.
dashboard.exportCardHint: Download your synced data - to move passwords to another manager, or keep an encrypted copy you can restore from the extension. Asks for your recovery passphrase each time.
dashboard.exportCsvWarning: The CSV file is NOT encrypted: anyone who opens it can read every password. Import it where you need it and delete it right after.
dashboard.confirmLogout: Log out of the dashboard in this browser? Your data and your devices aren't affected.
dashboard.deleteAccountHint: Permanently deletes your account, every synced item (bookmarks, history, extensions, passwords) and signs out every device. It cannot be undone - export a backup first if you might want your data later.
dashboard.confirmDeleteAccount: Delete {{email}} and all its synced data for good? This cannot be undone.
dashboard.enterPasswordToDelete: Enter your account password to confirm.
dashboard.accountDeleted: Your account and all its data were deleted.
